text: DSH Token Gauge（DSH Web 插件）：在网页会话中查看累计 token、生成速度和估算费用。它作为浏览器端插件注册到 shell.overlay 浮层，读取当前会话的 tokenUsage 与 sessionStats 投影，并显示 token 总量、tok/s 和费用预算。面板支持拖动、调整大小和折叠，也会在浏览器本地记住位置、尺寸与折叠状态。适合想随时观察长会话消耗与输出表现的 DSH Web 用户。无需 API Key 或外部账号；费用采用内置参考单价估算。

DSH Token Gauge is a DSH Web plugin with a floating panel for session token totals, tok/s, and estimated cost. It reads current-session projections in the browser; users can drag, resize, and collapse it, with layout saved locally. No API key or account is needed; cost uses reference prices.

让 DSH Web 显示当前会话的 token 消耗。

Show me a live tokens-per-second reading in the DSH web app.
I want a small dashboard for session token totals and estimated spend.
DSH Token Gauge 的功能「会话 token 总量」：汇总当前会话的输入与输出 token，并在左侧仪表显示总量及输入细节。切换当前会话后读取对应投影。
DSH Token Gauge 的功能「生成速度」：每秒采样输出 token 增量并换算 tok/s；没有新的输出时，改用会话记录的平均解码速度。
DSH Token Gauge 的功能「费用估算」：按输入、缓存读写和输出 token 的内置参考单价计算美元估值，并在右侧仪表与预算刻度展示。
DSH Token Gauge 的功能「可调整浮层」：拖动标题移动面板、拖拽角落调整宽高、点击按钮折叠；浏览器会记住这些状态。
DSH Token Gauge 的费用数字按代码内的参考单价估算，并非网关账单；若实际模型价格不同，估值也会偏差。参考价格和预算刻度定义在 lib/client.js。

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · What it shows：| Dial | Scale | What the reading means |
|---|---|---|
| **Token Usage** (left) | 0 – 300M | Cumulative tokens across the whole session log. The needle climbing into the amber band means the model is reading far more context than it is producing — usually a sign the session has grown past what the model handles well. |
| **tok/s** (centre, largest) | 0 – 500 | Decode throughput, measured from the page's own observation (output tokens gained per second) and falling back to the session's recorded average while idle. Erratic readings are the tell for an unstable backend. |
| **Total Cost** (right) | 0 – $12 | Estimated spend against a budget, from reference token pricing. |

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · What it shows：Each dial carries a real scale with green / amber / red warning bands, a needle, the figure in large type inside the dial, and the fine detail (`In` / `Out` split, session average, budget) printed underneath — the way a car's cluster reads at a glance.

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · What it shows：Every figure comes from session projections the Web client already receives (`tokenUsage`, `contextPressure`, `contextBreakdown`, `sessionStats`). The plugin adds **no session events, no tools, and no model-visible content**: it is a read-only view, so it cannot affect a conversation.

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · Requirements：- DSH running the `web` profile (`dsh web` or `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`).
- DSH **0.1.5-rc.2** is what this is developed and tested against. The plugin consumes `ctx.sessions`, `ctx.slots`, and four projection keys; a DSH release that renames any of those needs a matching update here.

text: @stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · How it mounts：The panel registers into `shell.overlay` — the frame-wide, click-through `list` seat declared by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`. Contributing there is additive (a new `id` beside the shipped entries) and the layer is click-through, so the panel never blocks the app underneath.

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · How it mounts：```
T0  panel root                                       .td-root
├─ A   header (drag handle)                          .td-header
│  ├─ A1 grip · A2 title · A3 feed indicator · A4 route+session readout · A5 collapse
├─ B   dial cluster                                  .td-gauges

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · How it mounts：`A4` is the diagnostic line: it names the resolution route (`binding`, `scope`, or `unresolved`), the session id being read, and the current output-token count. When a figure looks wrong, that line says which session it came from.

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · Configuration：Scales and reference prices are constants at the top of `lib/client.js`:

```js
const SCALE_TOKENS = 300e6;   // left dial maximum
const SCALE_RATE   = 500;     // centre dial maximum
const SCALE_COST   = 12;      // right dial maximum, also the budget
const ZONES = { tokens: [0.5, 0.8], rate: [0.6, 0.84], cost: [0.5, 0.8] }; // amber, red

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · Configuration：**The cost dial is an estimate.** `deepseek-v4.1-flash` is absent from DSH's installed model catalog, so DSH computes no cost for it and there is no cost projection to read; the defaults mirror the catalog's `deepseek` family entry. Put your gateway's real per-million rates in `PRICES` — at a $12 scale, pricing accuracy is what makes the dial trustworthy. The dial is labelled `est.` for exactly this reason.

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · Development：`lib/client.js` is a **hand-authored ModuleLoader bundle**, not a build artifact: it keeps the exact shell DSH's client loader expects and resolves its externals with `require()` at load time. There is no build step and nothing to install.

```sh
node test/harness.mjs        # 61 checks
```

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · Development：The harness executes the real bundle against faithful stand-ins — the ModuleLoader facade, a React hook dispatcher with `Object.is` dependency comparison, `ctx.slots`, and `ctx.sessions` — covering registration, projection subscription, wire-shape normalisation, session switching, route fallbacks and retries, dragging, resizing, clamping, persistence, and disposal.

Two rules the tests encode, learned the hard way:

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · Development：- **Fixtures must use the wire shape.** Projections are published through a `wire.view` transform, and `tokenUsage` flattens to its four buckets (`view: state => state.totals`). A fixture that used the host-side nested shape once let a zero-figures bug ship.
- **A broken route must not look live.** Reading a face through `useSyncExternalStore` keeps the last snapshot across a re-subscribe, so the panel gates on the resolved face and reports `unresolved` rather than showing frozen numbers.

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · Development：Renaming the package touches the manifest, the bundle id, the loader row, the storage prefix, and the test expectations. Use the tool rather than editing by hand — it rewrites all of them and fails if the result is inconsistent:

```sh
node tools/rename.mjs @you/dsh-token-gauge
```

@stone100010/dsh-token-gauge README · Uninstall：```sh
./setup.sh uninstall     # or: dsh plugin --profile web remove @stone100010/dsh-token-gauge
```

Restart `dsh web` afterwards.
